assertions.assertion: Explains that the iss claim is derived from the request host by default, so different host names per region produce different issuers; every instance must resolve the same issuer (same public host/path base, or fixed IssuerUri for a single issuer)
assertions.rationale: Explains each host builds issuer from request host; use common host or IssuerUri.

assertions.assertion: States that operational data (grants, codes, refresh tokens) must be visible in every active region almost immediately, otherwise redemption fails with invalid_grant due to replication lag
assertions.rationale: Says replica lag means grant isn't in the other region, causing invalid_grant; requires strongly consistent writes.

assertions.assertion: Recommends sharing signing keys across regions via a shared key store
assertions.rationale: Recommends same static cert or shared key store.

assertions.assertion: Recommends sharing ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys and setting the same explicit application name
assertions.rationale: Shared Data Protection keys with same SetApplicationName.

assertions.assertion: Suggests active-passive/regional failover with defined RPO/RTO if synchronous consistency across regions is not achievable
assertions.rationale: No active-passive/failover or RPO/RTO suggestion; suggests sticky routing instead.
